meta.disclaimer: Coverage maps change. Register SIMs with your passport where required. Savanna Explorer does not sell SIMs — buy from official operator stores or airport kiosks.

intro: Local prepaid SIMs are usually cheaper than roaming for single-country trips. Multi-country loops may suit a regional eSIM — verify country list before purchase. Download offline maps before remote park routes.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.parkCoverage: Good on tar roads; patchy deep Kruger bush camps
countries.esim: Vodacom eSIM via app; Airalo ZA packs
countries.planningTip: Load data before entering Kruger — camp Wi‑Fi is slow.

countries.name: Namibia
countries.parkCoverage: Poor Skeleton Coast & Kaokoland — offline maps essential
countries.planningTip: MTC prepaid data bundles — top up in towns only.

countries.name: Botswana
countries.planningTip: Buy in Maun before Okavango fly-in camps.

countries.name: Zambia
countries.planningTip: Livingstone SIM before remote Luangwa drives.

countries.name: Zimbabwe
countries.parkCoverage: Hwange main roads OK; interior camps vary
countries.planningTip: USD cash for airtime top-ups common.

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.planningTip: Buy before Ponta do Ouro if overlanding from SA.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.planningTip: Lake ferry routes — download maps in Lilongwe.

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.esim: Use SA roaming or local SIM at border
countries.planningTip: Often easier to use SA Vodacom roaming short trips.

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.esim: Limited — SA roaming common for day trips
countries.planningTip: Day trips from Kruger — SA SIM often sufficient.

esimNote: Regional Africa eSIM packs (Airalo, Holafly, etc.) vary by country list — always confirm Zambia, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique are included before relying on one eSIM for a Vic Falls loop.
